decision.rationale: I'm asking the merchant for evidence. TXN-008150 is a charge of 59.13 EUR (5913 minor units) on card CRD-000202. Ashgrove Athletic Club (MER-000063), a fitness club that bills on a recurring basis, made the charge on 2026-09-14, and it posted on 2026-09-15. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 39 days after posting, which is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone but has nothing in writing, and no documents are attached. Without a cancellation confirmation from the merchant there is no effective cancellation date, so I can't tell whether the cancellation came before or after the charge. In this situation, recurring-no-proof says to ask the merchant for its cancellation records and the terms of the subscription.

proposed_actions.note: Regarding the subscription charge of 59.13 EUR made on 2026-09-14: please send your cancellation records for this cardholder's subscription, including any record of a phone cancellation request and when it took effect, and the cancellation terms that applied to the subscription.
